sql_templates.template:
SELECT 
    sector_daily.sector,
    AVG(sector_daily.pct_above_50dma) AS avg_pct_above_50dma,
    AVG(sector_daily.change_5d) AS avg_change_5d,
    AVG(ma_pct_above.stage2_pct) AS avg_stage2_pct
FROM 
    breadth.sector_daily sector_daily
JOIN 
    breadth.ma_pct_above ma_pct_above ON sector_daily.snapshot_date = ma_pct_above.snapshot_date
WHERE
    sector_daily.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)
GROUP BY 
    sector_daily.sector
ORDER BY 
    avg_stage2_pct DESC, avg_change_5d DESC
